author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I really think and I am not joking deserve credit for Baby Shark phenomenon.

When we traveled country as college kids we had two games "Hey Baby" and "Baby Shark"

If a friend pointed to stranger you either had to start convo with "Hey Baby" or sing them Baby Shark.
